newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Renong put option on Time stock.
newsitem.headline: Renong put option on Time stock.

text.p: Construction conglomerate Renong Bhd said on Tuesday, it has signed a put option on 112 million Time Engineering Bhd as part of an elaborate arrangement to help group company Time fund some acquisitions.
It said under the put option agreement, Renong has agreed to acquire the shares from Time Investments (Cayman) Ltd, a special purpose company set up to raise funds to buy Time Engineering shares.
A put option gives the option buyer, in this case Time Investments, a right to sell, but not the obligation, a specified asset at a specified price during a pre-determined period.

Time Investments, an offshore company incorporated in Cayman islands, will use the guarantee provided by the put option agreement to raise $262 million through a two-year floating rate notes issue with attached call warrants.

"To enhance the credit of (Time Investments), Renong has agreed to enter into the put option agreement," the statement said. The option is exercisable after two years when the floating rate notes mature.
Time Investments will then use the funds to buy Time Engineering shares.
Time Engineering is issuing shares to fund the acquisition of 75 percent equity in Sapura Digital Sdn Bhd and a 75 percent stake in Uniphone Sdn Bhd.
Time Engineering is issuing 246.46 million new shares at 4.95 ringgit each to Renong and through private placement by underwriter CIMB Securities.
Renong will take 115.28 million shares for 570.62 million ringgit and CIMB 131.19 million shares for 649.38 million ringgit.
The 112 million shares being acquired by Time Investments will come from CIMB's portion, the Renong statement said.
Under the funding arrangement by Schroders Malaysia (L) Bhd, the call warrants will be detached from the FRNs issued by Time Investments and subscribed by Schroders.

Schroders, in turn, will sell the call warrants, which entitle the holders to Time Engineering shares. Schroders has also signed an agreement to share any profit from the sale of these warrants with Renong.

However, if the call warrants are not exercised, that is if Time Investments is not able to sell all its Time Engineering shares before the maturity of the FRNs, Renong will have to pitch in for the amount that the Cayman islands-based company is falling short.
